The evidence explicitly describes 'Domain Repetition' as a technique used in raymarching with Signed Distance Fields (SDFs). Source [S1] details how to create infinite repetitions of objects in the xz-plane by taking the modulo of point coordinates, which is the core mechanism of domain repetition. Source [S2] also confirms this by stating that adding a mod call to the position before evaluating the SDF tiles the scene infinitely.
